propositions: An unchanged related-ticket pin fingerprinted under a supported historical generation (post-330c/pre-2be7) is incorrectly classified as stale-pin-drift when the latest fingerprint differs, despite the current material matching the historical generation recomputation exactly.

pin_health.derive_health compares signed pins only against the latest fingerprint and lacks the historical full-hash compatibility check already applied to own-ticket attestations via attest._legacy_material_ok.

The attestation wrapper attest.derive_plan_material_pin_health must supply a compatibility predicate to classify mismatched latest fingerprints as current when a supported historical generation recomputation of current material matches the signed pin byte-for-byte.

Related pins should invalidate only after actual plan-material drift, not fingerprint algorithm evolution, per jira-reb-1160; recovery must succeed when review-time related material remains unchanged.
